# tosijs-pattern v0.1.0-dev

Matching that reads like what it means: a fluent, declarative alternative to regular expressions.

- Docs: https://pattern.tosijs.net
- Source: https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-pattern
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tosijs-pattern

## Documentation

Full documentation, with live code examples, is at the links below.

Pages below are also available as plain markdown: append `index.md` to the URL
(for example `/guide/index.md`).
Prefer that if you only need the text. A page marked noindex has no markdown copy.

Live examples run inline on the shared page by default (not sandboxed):
each has its own `preview` element, but they share one tosijs module, so
`tosi()` state singletons are shared across every example on a page. This is
deliberate (it shows tosi isolation and lets you drive demos via the global
singleton). Namespace example state with unique top-level keys so examples
don't clobber each other; the `iframe` attribute isolates DOM/CSS, not state.

## Pages

- https://pattern.tosijs.net/formal/ — A formal specification in Lean 4
  A proposed Lean 4 specification of Pattern: the properties worth proving, and how the TypeScript engine is tested against it.
- https://pattern.tosijs.net/design/ — Design
  Why tosijs-pattern works the way it does: its speed, and the plan for a formal specification.
- https://pattern.tosijs.net/from-regex/ — From regex
  fromRegex(): translate a regex into an equivalent pattern where that is provable, or refuse it with the reason. With the numbers over real code.
- https://pattern.tosijs.net/guide/ — Guide
  Using tosijs-pattern: the vocabulary, and turning existing regexes into patterns.
- https://pattern.tosijs.net/performance/ — Performance
  How fast tosijs-pattern is against native regex and a linear regex engine, why, and the plan to close the gap.
- https://pattern.tosijs.net/ — tosijs-pattern
  Matching that reads like what it means: a fluent, declarative alternative to regular expressions, with no backtracking and a step budget.
- https://pattern.tosijs.net/vocabulary/ — Vocabulary
  Every noun and verb in tosijs-pattern, what each matches, and the values and captures a pattern gives back.
